metadata.description: Équipe virtuelle de 16 Heads of (Launch, Sales, Finance, Product, etc.) — chaque persona orchestre plusieurs skills via une slash command.

plugins.name: head-of-launch
plugins.description: Head of Launch — orchestre un lancement produit complet (stratégie + checklist + ads + email). Slash: /launch

plugins.name: head-of-consulting
plugins.description: Head of Consulting — onboarde un client PME de A à Z (JTBD + process + diagnostic + roadmap + proposition). Slash: /consulting

plugins.name: head-of-finance
plugins.description: Head of Finance / CFO — prépare un pack levée early-stage (memo + modèle + pitch deck + investor update). Slash: /fundraising

plugins.name: head-of-sales
plugins.description: Head of Sales — construit un GTM B2B multi-canal (concurrence + script + outbound + LinkedIn + partenariats). Slash: /sales

plugins.name: head-of-content
plugins.description: Head of Content — transforme 1 source en 10+ formats (blog SEO + LinkedIn + Reels + hooks). Slash: /content

plugins.name: head-of-seo
plugins.description: Head of SEO — domine une verticale en 6-12 mois (audit + cluster + articles + meta + maillage + schema). Slash: /seo

plugins.name: head-of-product
plugins.description: Head of Product — Discovery + PRD + roadmap + OKRs + analyse concurrentielle. Slash: /product

plugins.name: head-of-people
plugins.description: Head of People (RH) — fiches de poste + délégation + OKRs équipe + meeting prep. Slash: /people

plugins.name: head-of-operations
plugins.description: Head of Operations — cartographie process + SOPs + délégation + weekly review + OKRs ops. Slash: /operations

plugins.name: head-of-engineering
plugins.description: Head of Engineering / CTO — code review + Next.js + Supabase + TypeScript strict + Claude API. Slash: /engineering

plugins.name: head-of-design
plugins.description: Head of Design — identité de marque + design d'interface impeccable (OKLCH, typo, layout). Slash: /design

plugins.name: head-of-data
plugins.description: Head of Data — analyse de données + métriques SaaS (MRR, churn, CAC, LTV, cohort). Slash: /data

plugins.name: head-of-growth
plugins.description: Head of Growth — funnel AARRR + email + ads + e-commerce + hooks. Slash: /growth

plugins.name: head-of-customer-success
plugins.description: Head of Customer Success — onboarding + Health Score + entretiens + email lifecycle. Slash: /customer-success

plugins.name: head-of-pr
plugins.description: Head of PR — relations presse + personal branding founder + LinkedIn. Slash: /pr

plugins.name: head-of-academy
plugins.description: Head of Academy / Formation — architecture pédagogique + auto-école + lifecycle apprenant + landing. Slash: /academy

plugins.name: head-of-legal
plugins.description: Head of Legal - juridique + conformité (droit des sociétés, RGPD, EU AI Act, droit du travail, CGV/CGU) + revue de contrats. Slash: /legal

plugins.name: head-of-controlling
plugins.description: Head of Controlling - pilotage financier d'exploitation (contrôle de gestion, trésorerie 13 semaines, fiscalité PME). Slash: /controlling

plugins.name: head-of-supply
plugins.description: Head of Supply - achats + supply chain + production lean (Kraljic, S&OP, stocks, TRS/OEE). Slash: /supply

plugins.name: head-of-risk
plugins.description: Head of Risk - cartographie des risques + assurances + continuité d'activité (PCA/PRA, gestion de crise). Slash: /risk

plugins.name: head-of-sustainability
plugins.description: Head of Sustainability - RSE + CSRD/ESG + bilan carbone (double matérialité, scopes 1/2/3, décarbonation). Slash: /sustainability
